svg.title: Moki, under the hood
svg.desc: A browser reaches a Node server through a private gateway. The server runs agent turns and one build at a time. Narrow model agents share one plan, code gates check it, and subprocess workers produce the schematic, PCB, case and firmware, shown here with real output from one build. Agents read a parts catalog, datasheets and a block library. Nemotron 3.5 Parse on Modal reads datasheet tables and layout.
svg.text: Models decide. Code builds and checks. One plan holds it together.

g.text: Blue landing and project gallery with server-rendered thumbnails
Studio: schematic canvas with editing; PCB, 3D, Case, Firmware tabs

svg.text: HTTPS: JSON, BUILD FILES, SSE EVENTS

g.text: Sogo Apps gateway: a private, authenticated link
Saved as JSON and files in var/
One build at a time, up to 5 waiting

svg.text: THE JOB API THE STUDIO USES

g.text: Write the plan and new blocks

svg.text: A failed gate stops the build, or goes to the Fixer for at most 2 tries

g.text: Runs on Modal; pdf.js is the fallback

svg.text: Board pictures are real output from one temp-monitor build. Nothing has been fabricated or powered.
